info.title: VA CMS REST API
info.description: Headless content management API for VA CMS. BRD FR-DEV-01: OpenAPI 3.0 spec auto-generated from controllers.

get.summary: List all AD group → role mappings.

post.summary:
Create (or re-acknowledge) an AD group → role mapping.
Idempotent: if the (AdGroup, RoleId) pair already exists the call
succeeds and returns the existing record's Id.

delete.summary: Delete an AD group → role mapping by Id.

get.summary:
List audit log rows, newest first, with optional filters.
Acceptance criteria:
  - /admin/audit lists all AuditLog rows, newest first
  - Filters: User (actorId), Action Type (action), Entity Type (entityType), Date Range (fromDate, toDate)

parameters.name: fromDate
parameters.description: ISO 8601 UTC date-time — include rows on or after.

parameters.name: toDate
parameters.description: ISO 8601 UTC date-time — include rows on or before.

parameters.name: outcome
parameters.description: Filter by outcome: Success or Failure (#165).

parameters.name: ipAddress
parameters.description: Filter by exact source IP address (#165).

get.summary:
Export filtered audit log rows as a CSV file (up to 1000 rows).
Acceptance criteria: Exports filtered results to CSV.

parameters.name: fromDate
parameters.description: ISO 8601 UTC date-time — include rows on or after.

parameters.name: toDate
parameters.description: ISO 8601 UTC date-time — include rows on or before.

parameters.name: outcome
parameters.description: Filter by outcome: Success or Failure (#165).

parameters.name: ipAddress
parameters.description: Filter by exact source IP address (#165).

get.summary: List content entries. All CMS roles permitted.

post.summary:
Create a new content entry. Requires CanWrite.
ContentOwner: section scope enforced by checking slug against assigned section.

get.summary: Get a single content entry by id. All CMS roles permitted.

patch.summary:
Update content entry fields. Requires CanWrite.
ContentOwner: section scope enforced against the entry's slug.

delete.summary:
Archive (soft-delete) a content entry. Requires CanWrite.
ContentOwner: section scope enforced.

post.summary: Submit content for review (Draft → InReview). Requires CanWrite.

Approve or publish content. Requires CanPublish (Editor, SiteAdmin, SystemAdmin).
ContentOwner and ReadOnly receive 403.

Return content to the author (InReview → Draft). A comment is required.
Requires CanPublish (reviewers).

Direct publish. Requires CanPublish.
Issue #43 — FR-MEDIA-05: blocks publish if any referenced image asset lacks alt text.
Issue #66 — FR-AUTH-02a: regenerates RenderedFieldsJson on publish.
Issue #39 — FR-WORKFLOW-02: notifies the entry owner (in-app + email).
Unpublish. Requires CanPublish.

Archive via the workflow state machine (Published/Approved → Archived), logging a
WorkflowTransition row. Requires CanPublish. Issue #37.
DELETE /api/v1/content/{id} remains the unconditional soft-delete for authors.

patch.summary:
Update a content entry's slug.
Validates uniqueness within locale; creates a 301 redirect if the entry is Published.
Issue #33: FR-NAV-05.

post.summary:
Duplicate a content entry (issue #36, BRD FR-AUTH-07).
Creates a new Draft with '(Copy)' appended to title, slug cleared,
all field values copied, media references shared (not re-uploaded).
Requires CanWrite.

patch.summary:
Set or clear scheduled publish/expire times for a content entry.
Issue #35: BRD FR-AUTH-04.
Content owner can set a 'Publish at' datetime on a draft (AC1).
Content owner can set an 'Expire at' datetime on a published entry (AC3).
Requires CanWrite.

post.summary:
Sync media asset usage for a content entry.
Called by the admin SPA whenever the field state changes (draft save or publish).
            
AC (Issue #44 — FR-MEDIA-06):
  MediaUsage rows created/removed when assets are added/removed from content fields.
            
Replaces all MediaUsage rows for this entry with the provided list.
Idempotent: sending the same set twice produces the same result.
Requires CanWrite.

get.summary:
List content entries for the admin list screen.
Paginated 25/page; supports filter by type, status, author, date range.
Sortable by Title, Status, UpdatedAt.
Returns all registered content types with a summary of each type's fields.

Returns the full definition for a single content type including its
ordered field list with name, type, required flag, and constraints.

List all versions for a content entry.
Returns: version number, author, date, change note, status.
Get a specific version by id.

post.summary:
Restore a prior version. Sets the current draft fields to the selected version's
FieldsJson by creating a NEW version row — history is never deleted.
Requires CanWrite.

get.summary: Returns all registered custom field type plugins.

Returns combined database health: index fragmentation, table sizes,
and any queries running longer than 5 seconds.
Requires SystemAdmin role.

Lists the UPNs permitted for DevBypass sign-in. Used by the admin SPA login
page to render a dev user picker. 404 when DevBypass is not active so the
SPA falls back to the normal AD login flow.

post.summary:
Accepts an X-Dev-User header and issues a CMS JWT without AD.
Returns 401 if DevBypass mode is not active.

get.summary:
Stream a stored file. Files are stored outside the web root (FR-SECURITY-06)
so this is the only way they are exposed. ?variant=webp returns the generated
WebP rendition when one exists.
            
#158 audience rule: anonymous callers only get assets that published content
references (MediaUsage joined to a Published entry); anything else needs a
CanRead bearer token and answers 404 otherwise. Every response is nosniff;
raster images and SVG render inline under a sandbox CSP (SVG additionally
default-src 'none'); PDF renders inline without sandbox (browsers' PDF viewers
refuse a sandboxed document); everything else is an attachment. Caching is a
short public TTL with an ETag for public assets and private for the rest.

post.summary:
Upload a media file (multipart/form-data).
            
AC: POST /api/v1/media/upload accepts multipart file.
AC: Storage backend selected by config (local, unc).
AC: File stored outside web root.
AC: File extension validated against MIME allow-list (BRD FR-SECURITY-06).
AC: MediaAsset row created with path, MIME, size, dimensions.

get.summary:
List media assets.
            
AC (Issue #42):
  - Grid and list view is a client-side toggle; server returns items.
  - Search by filename, alt text (q param maps to searchTerm in SP).
  - Filter by MIME type (mimeType param, e.g. "image/") and date range.
  - Paginated (page, pageSize).

Get a single media asset with full metadata and usage list.
            
AC (Issue #42): Click to view detail: preview, alt text, usage list, metadata.

patch.summary:
Update alt text, title, description, and/or tags for a media asset.
            
AC (Issue #42): Edit alt text inline in detail view.

delete.summary:
Delete a media asset. Blocked (409) when the asset is referenced by any content entry.
The 409 body includes the list of content entries (title, slug, status) currently using the asset.
            
AC (Issue #44 — FR-MEDIA-06):
  DELETE returns 409 with usage list if asset is in use.

get.summary:
Return the navigation tree for the given handle as nested JSON.
Flat rows from the SP are assembled into a parent→children hierarchy here
so the public site only needs one HTTP call and zero tree-walking.
            
Returns 404 when the menu handle is not found in the database.
Returns an empty items array [] when the menu exists but has no visible items.

delete.summary: Delete a navigation menu and all its items.

get.summary: List all navigation menus.

post.summary: Create a new navigation menu.

get.summary:
List all items in a menu — includes hidden items.
Returns items as a flat list ordered by ParentItemId, SortOrder.
The admin UI assembles the tree from this flat list.

post.summary: Create a new navigation item in a menu.

patch.summary: Update a navigation item (label, URL, visibility, target).

delete.summary: Delete a navigation item and all its children.

post.summary:
Apply drag-and-drop reorder: update SortOrder and ParentItemId for all items.
Validates that no item exceeds 3 levels deep.
Request body: array of { id, parentItemId, sortOrder }.

get.summary:
Returns the menu tree as nested JSON — same shape as the public GET /navigation/{handle},
but includes hidden items so admins can preview the layout before saving.
Newest-first inbox for the current user, with the unread count for the badge.
Unread count only — for the bell badge poll.

post.summary: Mark the listed notifications read. Ids that are not the caller's are ignored.
Mark every unread notification read.

Issue a signed preview token for the given content entry.
Requires an authenticated session (CanRead).  Returns a token valid for 60 minutes.
            
AC: Preview does not require publishing — a token is minted for any draft.

Render arbitrary Markdown to HTML using the same Markdig DisableHtml() pipeline
used at publish time.  Issue #65 — Milkdown split-pane live preview.
            
Called by the admin SPA MarkdownField component, debounced 500ms, as the user
types in the Milkdown editor.  Returns raw HTML fragment (not a full page).
            
DisableHtml() is enforced on the server side — raw HTML entries in the Markdown
source are stripped, matching the publish pipeline exactly.
            
Requires CanRead — no anonymous access.

get.summary:
Render the USWDS public preview page for a content entry.
Authentication: signed preview token (no session cookie required).
            
Query params:
  token  — required.  Signed preview token from POST /preview-token.
  fields — optional. URL-encoded JSON of current field values from the admin form
           (unsaved state).  When present, these values override the saved draft
           for the preview — no publish required.
            
Returns an HTML document using the USWDS template.

Get a published content entry by slug for public rendering.
Returns 404 when no published entry exists for the slug, or when
type is supplied and does not match the entry's content type.

List redirects with pagination.
Optional query string: isActive=true|false (omit for all).

post.summary: Create a new redirect rule.

patch.summary: Edit an existing redirect's FromPath, ToPath, and/or StatusCode.

get.summary:
Full-text search over published content.
            
Parameters:
  q          — required; the search query string.
  type       — optional; filter by ContentTypeId (exact match).
  from       — optional; ISO 8601 UTC date — only entries published on/after.
  to         — optional; ISO 8601 UTC date — only entries published on/before.
  tag        — optional; taxonomy term ID — only entries tagged with this term.
  page       — optional; 1-based page number (default 1).
  pageSize   — optional; results per page, 1–search.maxPageSize (default search.defaultPageSize).
            
Response body:
  {
    "query":      "...",
    "page":       1,
    "pageSize":   25,
    "totalItems": N,
    "items": [
      {
        "id":              123,
        "title":           "...",
        "slug":            "...",
        "contentTypeId":   1,
        "contentTypeName": "Standard Page",
        "excerpt":         "...",
        "publishedAt":     "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
        "rank":            N
      },
      ...
    ]
  }
            
When Full-Text Search is not installed on the SQL Server instance,
the SP returns an empty result set — this endpoint returns 200 with 0 items.

GET /api/v1/admin/search/analytics/summary
Returns top 10 queries and top 10 zero-result queries over the last 30 days.
Requires any CMS role (admin users only).

GET /api/v1/admin/search/analytics
Full paginated analytics table with CTR, used by /admin/search/analytics page.
Requires any CMS role.

post.summary:
POST /api/v1/search/click
Records a user click on a search result for CTR analytics.
Public endpoint — no JWT required (called from public site search).
Body: { query, clickedSlug, resultRank }

get.summary:
Returns all pinned results, ordered by query string.
Optionally filter to a single query by passing ?q=…
            
Response body:
  {
    "items": [
      {
        "id":                 1,
        "queryString":        "va benefits",
        "contentEntryId":     42,
        "createdAt":          "2026-09-15T12:00:00Z",
        "entrySlug":          "benefits/overview",
        "entryStatus":        "Published",
        "entryContentTypeId": 1,
        "entryTitle":         "VA Benefits Overview"
      },
      …
    ]
  }

delete.summary:
Removes a pin by Id.
Returns 204 No Content on success (even if the pin did not exist).

get.summary: Public-scoped settings as a flat key → value map.
Admin- and Public-scoped settings as a flat key → value map.
List every setting with its current value, default, type and description.

put.summary: Set a value. Bool must be "true"/"false", int a non-negative whole number, json valid JSON.

post.summary: Restore the code default for a setting.

get.summary: List active users with optional name/email search.
Get a single user with their role assignments.
Get all role assignments for a user.

post.summary:
Assign a role to a user, optionally scoped to a section. The stored procedure audits
the change and ends the user's open sessions (#163/#165): the new role set takes
effect at their next sign-in rather than whenever the old token would have expired.

delete.summary: Revoke a role from a user.

post.summary:
Deactivate a user — sets IsActive=0 and ends every open session (#163): refresh
tokens are revoked and the session version bumped, so their existing access
token is refused within auth.revocationCheckSeconds on every node.

get.summary: List all roles (for role assignment dropdown).
List all content sections (for section-scoped role assignment).

post.summary: Register a new webhook endpoint.

get.summary: List all registered webhooks. Secret is not returned.

BlockingAssetItem.description: A single asset blocking publish due to missing alt text.

ContentEntryAdminPageDto.description: API response shape for the admin content entry list.

ContentEntryAdminRowDto.description: Single row in the admin content entry list response.

ContentEntryCreateRequest.description:
Create request. Supply either VA.CMS.API.Controllers.ContentEntryCreateRequest.ContentTypeId (DB id) or
VA.CMS.API.Controllers.ContentEntryCreateRequest.ContentTypeName (registry name, e.g. "standard_page"). Optional
VA.CMS.API.Controllers.ContentEntryCreateRequest.FieldsJson seeds the initial version.

ContentEntryDetailResponse.description:
Content entry API response including rendered fields — issue #66, BRD FR-AUTH-02a.
markdownBody: raw CommonMark Markdown stored in FieldsJson (from joined ContentVersion).
renderedBody: server-rendered HTML via Markdig DisableHtml() pipeline.
Both fields are null when the entry has no published version yet.

ContentEntryScheduleRequest.description:
Request body for PATCH /api/v1/content/{id}/schedule.
Issue #35: BRD FR-AUTH-04.
Both fields are optional — null clears the value; omitting a field leaves it unchanged.

ContentEntryUpdateRequest.description:
Update request. VA.CMS.API.Controllers.ContentEntryUpdateRequest.FieldsJson (a JSON object of field values) is saved as
a new Draft version; omit it to only touch UpdatedAt.

ContentPublishBlockedResponse.description:
Response body when POST /api/v1/content/{id}/publish is blocked due to missing alt text.
Issue #43 — FR-MEDIA-05.

ContentReturnRequest.description: Body for POST /api/v1/content/{id}/return — a comment is required.

ContentTransitionErrorResponse.description: 422 body when usp_Workflow_Transition rejects a state change.

ContentTypeDetailDto.description: Full detail returned by the single-type endpoint.

ContentTypeSummaryDto.description: Summary row returned by the list endpoint.

ContentVersionDetailDto.description: Full version detail including FieldsJson (for restore preview).

ContentVersionRestoreResponse.description: Restore response — carries the new version id.

ContentVersionSummaryDto.description: Version list row — AC: version number, author, date, change note, status.

CreateAdGroupMappingRequest.description: Request body for creating an AD group mapping.

CreateMappingResponse.description: Response body after a successful create.

CreateMenuRequest.description: Request body for creating a navigation menu.

CreatePinResponseDto.description: Response body for a successful POST /api/v1/admin/search/pins.

typeName.description: Unique machine-readable type name (matches the React registry key).

CustomFieldTypeDto.description: Summary of a registered custom field type plugin.

FieldSchemaDto.description: A single field definition in the schema viewer.

MediaAssetSummary.description: Summary item returned in GET /api/v1/media list.

MediaDeleteBlockedResponse.description:
409 Conflict body when DELETE /api/v1/media/{id} is blocked because
the asset is referenced by one or more content entries.
AC (Issue #44 — FR-MEDIA-06): response includes the full usage list.

MediaDeleteBlockedUsage.description: A single content entry that is blocking the media asset delete.

MediaDetailResponse.description: Detail response for GET /api/v1/media/{id}, including usage list.

MediaUploadResponse.description: Response body for a successful media upload.

fieldName.description: Field name in the content type schema, e.g. "featuredImage".

MediaUsageItem.description: A single asset reference in a content entry field.

MediaUsageSummary.description: A single usage record: which content entry + field references this asset.

NavItemAdminDto.description: Admin view of a navigation item — includes visibility and depth.

NavItemDto.description: A single navigation item, potentially nested via Children.

NavPreviewItemDto.description: Preview tree node — includes IsVisible so admin preview can dim hidden items.

NavigationMenuPreviewResponse.description: Preview response — nested tree with visibility info.

PreviewRenderRequest.description:
Request body for POST /api/v1/preview/render (issue #65).
Accepts a CommonMark Markdown string to render via Markdig.

PreviewRenderResponse.description:
Response from POST /api/v1/preview/render — issue #66, BRD FR-AUTH-02b.
Returns sanitised HTML fragment (not a full page) — DisableHtml() applied.
Field name is renderedHtml per acceptance criteria.

RedirectAdminDto.description: Single redirect row returned by the API.

ReorderItemRequest.description: Single item in a bulk-reorder request.

SearchAnalyticsRowDto.description: Single row in the full analytics table.

SearchPinDto.description: Single pin row returned by GET /api/v1/admin/search/pins.

title.description:
Title extracted from FieldsJson 'title' field.
Null when the content type has no title field.

contentTypeName.description: Human-readable content type name (e.g. "News Article", "Standard Page").

excerpt.description:
Summary excerpt — 'summary' field from FieldsJson when present,
otherwise first 300 chars of extracted plain text from all fields.

publishedAt.description: When the entry was last published (ContentEntry.UpdatedAt at publish time).

rank.description: Full-text search rank score (higher = more relevant).

SearchResultDto.description:
Single result item returned by GET /api/v1/search.
Fields mapped from usp_Search_FullText via SearchResult POCO.

usages.description:
Current set of media asset references in this content entry's fields.
Each item maps one asset to the field that references it.
Sending an empty list clears all MediaUsage rows for this entry.

SyncMediaUsageRequest.description:
Request body for POST /api/v1/content/{id}/sync-media-usage.
Issue #44 — FR-MEDIA-06: sync media usage rows when content fields change.

TopQueryDto.description: Single row in the top-queries widget.

UpdateMenuRequest.description: Request body for renaming a navigation menu.

UpsertItemRequest.description: Request body for creating or updating a navigation item.

secret.description: Optional — server generates one if omitted.
Returned once at registration. Store it — the server will not show it again.

ZeroResultQueryDto.description: Single row in the zero-result queries widget.

Bearer.description: Enter your JWT access token (issued by /api/auth/login).
